issue.title: did.kr: narrow `||did.kr^$third-party` in Tracking Protection to track.did.kr and analytics.did.kr
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard Browser Extension

### AdGuard version

5.5.4.82

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Chrome

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://did.kr/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, AdGuard URL Tracking filter

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

Filter unblocking search ads and self-promotion

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

did.kr provides a chat widget that businesses embed on their own websites. The Tracking Protection rule `||did.kr^$third-party` blocks the whole domain, so on those sites the chat widget cannot open.

Reproduced with AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.4.82 (AdGuard Tracking Protection filter 2.1.16.18) on a site that embeds the widget: the chat shows an error and its requests to did.kr are blocked. Disabling AdGuard fixes it. We can share an example site privately if needed. Browser: Chrome 156, macOS.

All tracking from the widget now goes to separate hosts. The widget requests that remain on did.kr and cdn.did.kr only run the widget:

- Tracking: track.did.kr, analytics.did.kr
- Widget: did.kr, cdn.did.kr

Could `||did.kr^$third-party` be replaced with `||track.did.kr^$third-party` and `||analytics.did.kr^$third-party`? Visitors stay protected from tracking, and the widget keeps working.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition
